description: This file defines an abstraction over iOS's UserNotifications framework, providing a protocol and a concrete implementation for managing and requesting notification permissions and scheduling notifications.

classes.name: LiveNotificationCenter
classes.description: A concrete implementation of NotificationCentering that interacts with iOS's UserNotifications framework asynchronously.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current notification authorization status.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Requests user authorization for notifications with specified options.
